```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(readODS)

```


```{r}
ranks_WIMD <- read_ods(
  "../data/raw/wimd-2025-index-and-domain-ranks-by-small-area.ods",
  sheet = "WIMD_2025_ranks",
  skip  = 2
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  select(where(~!all(is.na(.)))) %>%      # drop trailing empty column (col 13)
  mutate(across(4:12, as.numeric)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lsoa_code))

cat("Ranks loaded:", nrow(ranks), "rows |", ncol(ranks), "cols\n")


```
```{r}
scores_WIMD <- read_ods(
  "../data/raw/wimd-2025-index-and-domain-scores-by-small-area.ods",
  sheet = "Data",
  skip  = 3
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(across(4:12, as.numeric)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lsoa_code))

cat("Scores loaded:", nrow(scores), "rows |", ncol(scores), "cols\n")

```

```{r}
rank_cols_drd <- c("wimd_2025_rank", "wimd_2019_rank", "wimd_2014_rank",
                   "wimd_2011_rank", "wimd_2008_rank", "wimd_2005_rank")

drd_WIMD <- read_ods(
  "../data/raw/welsh-index-of-multiple-deprivation-wimd-2025-data-underlying-deep-dooted-deprivation-analysis.ods",
  sheet = "Data",
  skip  = 4
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(!is.na(lsoa_code)) %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(rank_cols_drd),
    ~as.numeric(str_remove_all(as.character(.x), "[^0-9]"))
    # converts "[x]" suppression markers to NA
  ))

cat("DRD loaded:", nrow(drd_WIMD), "rows |", ncol(drd_WIMD), "cols\n")

```

```{r}
ruc_file <- list.files("../data/raw", pattern = "Rural_Urban", full.names = TRUE)

ruc_WIMD <- read_csv(ruc_file[1]) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(str_starts(lsoa21cd, "W"))       # Welsh LSOAs only

cat("RUC loaded:", nrow(ruc_WIMD), "rows |", ncol(ruc_WIMD), "cols\n")

```
```{r}
ranks_clean <- ranks_WIMD %>%
  rename(
    lsoa_name          = lsoa_name_eng,
    la_name            = local_authority_name_eng,
    wimd_2025_rank     = wimd_2025,
    income_rank        = income,
    employment_rank    = employment,
    health_rank        = health,
    education_rank     = education,
    access_rank        = access_to_services,
    housing_rank       = housing,
    community_safety_rank   = community_safety,
    physical_env_rank  = physical_environment
  )

```


```{r}
scores_clean <- scores_WIMD %>%
  select(-lsoa_name, -local_authority_name) %>%   # already in ranks; avoid duplication
  rename(
    wimd_2025_score    = wimd_2025,
    income_score       = income,
    employment_score   = employment,
    health_score       = health,
    education_score    = education,
    access_score       = access_to_services,
    housing_score      = housing,
    community_safety_score  = community_safety,
    physical_env_score = physical_environment
  )

```


```{r}
drd_clean <- drd_WIMD %>%
  select(
    lsoa_code,
    drd_category = category_of_deep_rooted_deprivation,
    wimd_2019_rank = wimd_2019_rank,
    wimd_2014_rank = wimd_2014_rank,
    wimd_2011_rank = wimd_2011_rank,
    wimd_2008_rank = wimd_2008_rank,
    wimd_2005_rank = wimd_2005_rank
    # wimd_2025_rank already in ranks_clean; excluded to avoid duplication
  )

```

```{r}
ruc_clean <- ruc_WIMD %>%
  select(
    lsoa_code      = lsoa21cd,
    ruc_code       = ruc21cd,
    ruc_name       = ruc21nm,
    rural_urban    = urban_rural_flag
  )

cat("Column rename done.\n")
cat("ranks_clean cols:", paste(names(ranks_clean), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("scores_clean cols:", paste(names(scores_clean), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("drd_clean cols:", paste(names(drd_clean), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("ruc_clean cols:", paste(names(ruc_clean), collapse = ", "), "\n")

```
```{r}
master <- ranks_clean %>%
  left_join(scores_clean, by = "lsoa_code") %>%
  left_join(drd_clean,    by = "lsoa_code") %>%
  left_join(ruc_clean,    by = "lsoa_code")

cat("Master dataset:", nrow(master), "rows |", ncol(master), "cols\n")
```

```{r}
master <- master %>%
  mutate(
    # Access rank discordance: difference between access rank and overall rank
    # NEGATIVE gap = LSOA is MORE access-deprived than its overall rank suggests
    # i.e. the LSOA appears less deprived overall than its access situation warrants
    # In WIMD: rank 1 = most deprived, rank 1917 = least deprived
    # Rural LSOAs expected to have large NEGATIVE gaps (access rank << overall rank)
    access_rank_gap = access_rank - wimd_2025_rank,

    # Housing rank discordance: same logic
    # NEGATIVE gap = LSOA is MORE housing-deprived than its overall rank suggests
    housing_rank_gap = housing_rank - wimd_2025_rank,

    # DRD category as ordered factor for plotting
    drd_category = factor(
      drd_category,
      levels = c(
        "LSOAs never ranked in top 50 most deprived",
        "LSOAs sometimes in the top 50 most deprived",
        "LSOAs often in the top 50 most deprived",
        "LSOAs in Deep-rooted deprivation"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),

    # Rural/urban as factor
    rural_urban = factor(rural_urban, levels = c("Rural", "Urban"))
  )

cat("Derived variables added.\n")
cat("access_rank_gap range:", range(master$access_rank_gap, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("housing_rank_gap range:", range(master$housing_rank_gap, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

```

```{r}
glimpse(master)
```

```{r}
master %>%
  group_by(rural_urban) %>%
  summarise(
    n                     = n(),
    median_overall_rank   = median(wimd_2025_rank,   na.rm = TRUE),
    median_income_rank    = median(income_rank,       na.rm = TRUE),
    median_employment_rank= median(employment_rank,   na.rm = TRUE),
    median_access_rank    = median(access_rank,       na.rm = TRUE),
    median_housing_rank   = median(housing_rank,      na.rm = TRUE),
    median_health_rank    = median(health_rank,       na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
master %>%
  filter(la_name %in% c("Powys", "Ceredigion", "Pembrokeshire", "Swansea")) %>%
  group_by(la_name, rural_urban) %>%
  summarise(
    n                   = n(),
    median_overall_rank = median(wimd_2025_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_access_rank  = median(access_rank,    na.rm = TRUE),
    median_housing_rank = median(housing_rank,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(la_name)

```
```{r}
write_csv(master, "../data/processed/master_dataset.csv")
cat("Master dataset saved to ../data/processed/master_dataset.csv\n")
cat("Final dimensions:", nrow(master), "rows |", ncol(master), "cols\n")

```
